author: CC (the instrument and the reading)
status: A MEASUREMENT, n=1, taken while clearing the watchme-spec corpus red. Not a ticket: nothing here asks to be built. It exists so the next mind does not re-derive whether the hand-transcription seam leaks.
the_question: /sorted's door judges a PACKET and writes a berth in instance-space. The ticket file in CairnCommons/tickets/ is then written BY HAND from that packet — the door does not write it. So the record of truth is a transcription of what was judged, and a transcription can differ from its source. Does it, today?
the_instrument: For every ticket whose `sorted_berth` names a berth file on disk, read the berth's `answers` and compare against the ticket: (a) the WORKFLOW CHAIN — class@vN plus the arrow sequence up to the terminal token, cursor brackets and any `:waiting` annotation removed, trailing voyage prose discarded because it is a note appended after the string rather than part of it; (b) the WATCH OBJECT — a lone dict normalized to a one-element list, a list reduced to its sorted objects, a reasoned `none` reduced to its collapsed text.
what_it_says: ON THE GATE-READABLE FIELDS THE SEAM IS FAITHFUL: 57 of 57, zero drift in the workflow chain and zero in the watch object. Those are the two fields a gate actually reads — the chokepoint parses the chain, the emission gate joins spec to object — so the fields that would cause a wrong refusal or a wrong pass are exactly the fields that agree. Every named berth resolves to a file that exists.
where_it_does_leak: FOUR OF FIFTY-SEVEN carry a CONDENSED RETELLING of a reasoned `none, because ...`: a-charter-may-not-assert-a-file-that-is-not-there, berths-carry-request-identity, tellmeabout, the-present-tense-corpus-rewrites-once. In each the ticket's text is shorter than the text the door judged and says the same thing — the referents survive, the qualifications survive, the sentences are tightened. Not a contradiction, and not nothing: the record of truth carries a paraphrase of what was judged, and a paraphrase is where a qualification goes to quietly stop being one. Worth a second reading if any of those four is ever leaned on.
the_bigger_number_and_what_it_is_not: 79 of 146 tickets carry no sorted_berth at all. That is NOT drift and must not be read as such — most predate the door (which opened 2026-08-03), and the population is already governed elsewhere: buildme_rides_the_sorted refuses a cast ticket's first crossing without the field, so a silent one costs a red at the edge rather than a wrong record. This note measures fidelity where a berth is named; it says nothing about the 79.
why_this_is_recorded_rather_than_built_i: The measurement came back clean, so a standing tooth would be a check that has never bitten — build minimal, grow against need. If a real drift ever appears, the instrument is three normalizations and a loop, and this note carries all three. The claim being pinned here is the one that would otherwise live as prose in a clear: 'the hand transcribes faithfully.' It does, at n=57, on 2026-08-17.
bearing: Taken while clearing troubles/cairn-tools-base-proofs-test-watchme-spec-py-is-red-at-head-... whose residue clause names the standing hole: /sorted's door judges packets, and a ticket written wholly by hand never touches it. This note bounds that hole — the hand's transcriptions are not where the corpus drifted; the five hand casts that never fired the door at all are.
